decision: Single-call boost rejected as likely wait redistribution; finite-batch boost warrants model evaluation only, not deployment or a boundedness/performance claim.

observed_source_facts.fact: Original IDF dual-core scheduler starts at ready-list head and moves each selected task to its priority-list tail. Higher-priority BTC preemption can therefore rotate BLE_TX behind other priority-7 peers without waiting for a tick.
vTaskPrioritySet lowering the running task sets xYieldRequired and yields after moving the ready item. A single-call 8-to-7 restoration can move the same wait outside sdkWallUs.

Current fragmentation checkpoints after at most four successful fragments OR an observed tick change, while more fragments remain. At HZ=100 this is tick-granular, not a hard 10ms call bound. Descriptor entry also checkpoints.

Original predicates remain 32 units OR 2-tick quantum OR 4-tick idle backstop. A due checkpoint performs exactly one vTaskDelay(1); real idle progress resets the local quantum. Lowering to priority 7 or taskYIELD alone cannot guarantee IDLE0.

The public send call deep-copies and posts to BTC with OSI_THREAD_MAX_TIMEOUT, reaching xQueueSend(portMAX_DELAY); no unconditional one-tick delay was found on this path. The caller cannot bound/cancel the individual SDK call using an outer deadline.
Preemption and time slicing enabled, maximum priorities25; BTC19 and BTU20 remain above both BLE7/8. This is same-priority service contention, not demonstrated mutex priority inversion.

candidate_for_future_model_only.scope: Current BLE_TX task only; FAST DATA only. Keep SAFE indications, CTRL, LOG, CRC/ASCII validation and fragment planning at the existing baseline priority.
candidate_for_future_model_only.batch_end: Existing 4-fragment/tick-change checkpoint, descriptor end, connection-generation mismatch or any send error; restore original base priority on every exit before retry/confirmation waits or release.
candidate_for_future_model_only.time_limit: Do not replace the existing tick-change check by a coarser 20ms test. An additional absolute wall limit can only be checked after SDK returns; an individual call can overshoot it.
candidate_for_future_model_only.yield_policy: First model restore7 plus unchanged WorkBudget. If actual vTaskDelay(1) after every batch is required, model separately as a changed scheduling policy with up-to-one-tick blocking cost; do not call that unchanged behavior.
candidate_for_future_model_only.control: CTRL worker stays8 and can time-slice with boosted owner. Control messages queued to the same BLE owner still wait for current DATA descriptor completion; queue priority is not mid-record preemption.
candidate_for_future_model_only.priority_ownership: No external task or effective inherited priority may be blindly overwritten; guard owner identity/base7 and restore once on every exit. No scheduler suspension, ISR blocking, task deletion or payload reuse to fake cancellation.

conditional_bounds.finite_sdk_assumption: With individual SDK wall time <=B and finite local overhead H, N<=4 and an after-return threshold T allow only a conditional batch bound <=min(N*B+H,T+B+H); H must include finite scheduling/ISR effects. No measured HIL maximum is a proof of B.
conditional_bounds.sdk_blocks_forever: Blocked owner does not itself consume CPU, but descriptor lifetime and same-owner CTRL delivery are unbounded. Keep slot owned, classify NOT_PROVABLY_BOUNDED.
conditional_bounds.sdk_ready_forever: A non-returning ready SDK call at8 would starve priority7 production/USB and cannot reach WorkBudget. This is an adversarial risk, not an observed SDK spin diagnosis; retain watchdog and reject any claim of hard bounded boost.
conditional_bounds.idle: A lower priority or yield to ready priority7 peers is not evidence IDLE0 ran; use actual idle hook generation and the existing idle-gap assertions.

model_acceptance_plan: Retain archived permanent-TX8 failed log and all old serial model assertions: sourceFrames200, controls40, idle gap<=6ticks, original control lifetime checks. Do not relabel the historical failure.
Use actual extracted production pipeline and bounded BLE4slot dependency. Add baseline7, historical permanent8, single-fragment boost and bounded-batch variants without editing production.

Scheduler adapter must reproduce IDF ready-list-tail movement on every selection, higher-priority wake preemption, self-lowering yield, affinity and 100Hz tick slicing; changing only a priority integer is insufficient.
Cover short SDK calls, BTC preemption, long finite queue blocking, rejection, congestion, unread peer, generation changes and control arrivals at every fragment boundary.
Assert every completion/error/stale branch returns to baseline priority; no priority boost around SAFE confirmation/retry wait, no held hardware lock at yield, no extra slot reuse.

Preserve exact source/encoder/transport/BLE/SDK/receiver conservation and distinct drop counters; measure descriptor hold time, control dispatch/delivery, actual idle progress and maximum boosted wall interval.
Include indefinitely blocked SDK and adversarial ready/nonreturning SDK as NOT_PROVABLY_BOUNDED, not successful finite expiry; never discard owned payloads to satisfy teardown.
Performance admission must compare receiver-complete messages and layer drops plus upstream/USB/control progress; reduced sdkWallUs alone can be accounting displacement, not throughput improvement.
out_of_scope: No model execution for this new candidate
